source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Meselson-Stahl experiment (PDF 124-125).

blocks.text: 1958 mein do American biologists, Matthew Meselson aur Franklin Stahl, ne DNA replication ke teenon models ko parkha aur saabit kiya ke DNA replication semi-conservative model ke mutabiq hoti hai.

Unhon ne bacteria ko aise medium mein ugaya jis mein nitrogen ka bhaari isotope, ¹⁵N, tha. Bacteria ki agli nasl (generation) ne DNA ke nitrogen bases mein normal ¹⁴N ki jagah ¹⁵N shamil kar liya. Kai naslon ke baad in bacteria ka DNA normal bacteria ke DNA se zyada ghana (dense, yaani bhaari) ho gaya. Phir unhon ne in bacteria (jin ke DNA mein ¹⁵N tha) ko ¹⁵N wale medium se nikaal kar aise medium mein daala jis mein ¹⁴N tha. Un ka khayal tha ke ab bacteria medium ki ¹⁴N se naya DNA banayenge.

Jab bacteria divide ho kar barhte gaye to Meselson aur Stahl ne mukhtalif waqfon (intervals) par naya DNA jama kiya aur dekha ke kitna DNA bhaari (¹⁵N wala) hai aur kitna halka (¹⁴N wala). Bhaari aur halke DNA ko alag karne ke liye yeh qadam uthaye:

items: Jama kiya hua DNA cesium chloride ke paani wale mehlool (aqueous solution) mein ghola aur us ki ultracentrifugation ki (bohat tezi se ghumaya).
Ultracentrifugation se cesium ki density ka gradient (darja ba darja farq) ban gaya: zyada ghana cesium neeche baith gaya. Isi dauran mukhtalif density ke DNA strands bhi alag ho gaye.
Har DNA us jagah ruk gaya jahan us ki density wahan ke cesium ki density ke bilkul barabar thi. ¹⁵N wala bhaari DNA ¹⁴N wale halke DNA se zyada neeche gaya.
Pehla namoona (sample) 0 minute par liya gaya, yaani koi replication hone se pehle. Saare DNA ne bhaari density ki aik hi tah (sediment) banayi. Matlab saara DNA bhaari (¹⁵N wala) tha.

Doosra namoona 20 minute par liya gaya, jab bacteria ¹⁴N medium mein pehli replication mukammal kar chuke the. Is ne darmiyani (intermediate) density ki aik hi tah banayi. Matlab saare DNA ki density ¹⁴N-DNA aur ¹⁵N-DNA ke darmiyan thi.
Teesra namoona 40 minute baad liya gaya jab doosri replication ho chuki thi. Is mein DNA ne do tahein banayin: aik darmiyani aur aik halki (¹⁴N-DNA ke barabar).

blocks.title: Nasl mein radio-isotope label wale DNA ka peecha
blocks.text:
Aisa tajarba jis mein radio-isotope label wale DNA ko kisi jandar ki nasl (progeny) mein dhoonda (trace kiya) jaye, "pulse-chase experiment" kehlata hai. Is ke do marhale hain:
• "Pulse" marhale mein jandar ko thori der ke liye radio-isotope diya jata hai; is dauran woh isotope ko apne DNA mein shamil kar leta hai.
• “Chase” marhale mein label wale DNA ko waqt ke saath us ki radioactivity naap kar dekha jata hai.
Meselson aur Stahl ke tajarbe ki wazahat

items: Replication se pehle wala DNA sab se bhaari tha kyun ke us ke dono strands ¹⁵N ke the.
Pehli replication ke baad DNA darmiyani density ka tha kyun ke har daughter DNA hybrid tha: aik strand ¹⁴N ka aur aik ¹⁵N ka.

Doosri replication ke baad DNA ki do tahein banin (aik darmiyani, aik halki), kyun ke har parent DNA ne apna aik bhaari strand aik naye hybrid DNA ko diya aur aik halka strand aik halke DNA (dono strands ¹⁴N) ko diya.

blocks.text: In nataij ki bunyad par unhon ne kaha ke DNA semi-conservative tareeqe se replicate hota hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: 15N wale medium (gulabi flask) mein uge bacteria 14N wale medium (neela flask) mein muntaqil hote hain. Baen taraf 14N flasks: koi replication nahi, aik round aur do rounds. Har namoone ka DNA CsCl mehlool (solution) mein ultracentrifuge hota hai. Tubes: aik bhaari patti; aik darmiyani patti; aik halki aur aik darmiyani patti. Saath DNA molecules (surkh 15N, neele 14N strands) aur Light-Heavy paimane par DNA pattiyon ki tasveerein.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.9: Meselson-Stahl tajarbe ke nataij (kitab ki Figure 19.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Patti labels: 15N-15N All DNA heavy; 15N-14N All DNA intermediate density; 50% 15N-14N DNA intermediate density, 50% 14N-14N DNA light density.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har tah (band) DNA ki density batati hai: bhaari ¹⁵N-¹⁵N DNA neeche, halka ¹⁴N-¹⁴N DNA oopar, aur hybrid ¹⁵N-¹⁴N darmiyan mein. Aik replication ke baad sirf darmiyani tah, aur do replications ke baad aadhi darmiyani aur aadhi halki: yahi semi-conservative replication hai.

blocks.prompt: 20 minute par sirf aik darmiyani tah (band) conservative model ko kyun ghalat saabit karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Conservative model ke mutabiq aik replication ke baad do tahein banteen: aik bhaari (dono strands ¹⁵N) aur aik halki (dono strands ¹⁴N). Hybrid wali aik hi darmiyani tah sirf tab banti hai jab har naye DNA mein aik purana aur aik naya strand ho.

items: ¹⁵N mein uge bacteria ¹⁴N medium mein; DNA ko cesium chloride mein ultracentrifuge kiya.
0 minute: bhaari; 20 minute: darmiyani (hybrid); 40 minute: darmiyani + halki.
Yeh nataij sirf semi-conservative model se milte hain.
